scenes.title: The Storm Letter
scenes.card: A courier who never stops breaks her promise once, for a good reason, and it saves a ferry full of families from a storm.

scenes.title: Storm by sunset
scenes.card: Odile gives Pepper a storm warning for the ferry captain. The ferry sails at sunset.

subtitles.text: Odile: My barometer is falling like a stone. A great storm by sunset.
Odile: The ferry sails at sunset. Captain Tobias must read this letter. Do not stop for anything.
Pepper: I never stop!

hud.text: Sunset: warn the ferry in 3 hours

scenes.title: Vesper notices
scenes.card: Vesper spots the letter and seems curious. Pepper dodges her and runs on.

subtitles.text: Vesper: Where is the little courier going in such a hurry?
Pepper: Secret ferry business!
Vesper: Ferry business is my business.

scenes.title: Never stop... except
scenes.card: Pepper breaks her promise to help Old Mo. While her back is turned, Vesper takes the letter and runs.

subtitles.text: Old Mo: Stuck! Stuck again! These old wheels hate me!
Pepper: I never stop. I never stop. ...Oh, bother.
Old Mo: Bless you, child! Now run!
Pepper: Vesper! My letter!

scenes.title: The chase
scenes.card: Pepper races after Vesper through the market and past an angry toll keeper.

subtitles.text: Grub: No running in my market!

hud.text: The letter is stolen! 1 hour left

scenes.title: The broken bridge
scenes.card: Vesper reveals she was racing to warn the ferry too. Together they bridge the gap with a plank.

subtitles.text: Pepper: Give it back, Vesper!
Vesper: I read it. A storm! I was taking it to Tobias myself. You were too slow.
Pepper: You were warning him?
Vesper: But the bridge is out. We cannot cross.

scenes.title: The toll
scenes.card: The toll keeper blocks the way until Old Mo pays with an apple, to repay Pepper’s kindness.

subtitles.text: Grub: Toll bridge. One apple each. No apple, no crossing.
Vesper: We have no apples. A storm is coming!
Grub: No apple, no crossing.
Old Mo: These two children helped me with my cart. Grub, take mine.
Grub: ...Fine. Cross. But mind the thunder.

scenes.title: Last bell
scenes.card: At the last bell Pepper trips, Vesper helps her up, and they run the last steps together to hand over the letter.

subtitles.text: Pepper: Captain! A letter from Odile! A storm is coming!

scenes.title: The storm breaks
scenes.card: Tobias reads the letter, cancels the sailing, and the storm breaks over the empty ferry.

subtitles.text: Captain Tobias: A storm by sunset... Odile is never wrong.
Captain Tobias: Everybody off the ferry! Passengers to shelter! Now!
Captain Tobias: Fastest courier on the coast. And the best rival she will ever have.

scenes.title: Soup and thunder
scenes.card: Everybody shelters at the inn. The rivals become partners.

subtitles.text: Odile: Fourteen families would have sailed into that.
Captain Tobias: Thanks to a small fox who never stops. Almost never.
Vesper: Pepper, partner? The Harbour Couriers need a fast fox and a stylish cat.
Pepper: Deal. But I get to wear the cap.
